summary: Tested Assessment & Question Bank v2 (backend + frontend). All 8 backend pytest cases passed (bank-stats shape, 20-question sessions with adaptive_meta, repetition minimization, low-score→Easy skew, submit profile+xp+ai_report, progress aggregates, assessments list, PDF regression). Frontend assessment flow works: 20 questions load, difficulty_label ('Easy/Medium/Hard') is color-coded and correctly shown at data-testid='assessment-question-meta', and after answering all 20 the app transitions to the AI report generation screen before landing on /dashboard/report/:id.
critical_code_review_comments: Review-request mentioned route /dashboard/assessment/{child_id} — actual route is /dashboard/child/:childId/assessment (App.js line 60). Only a documentation/spec drift; UI works correctly.
server.py is 913 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, children, sessions, progress, admin) for maintainability.
questions_data.py '_rebalance_difficulty_labels' runs at import time and mutates the source list — fine, but worth adding a unit test to lock counts (75-100/age, ~1/3 each tier).
assessment_engine build_adaptive_session's weighted_sample uses random.uniform per pick which is O(n²); acceptable for n=20 but noted.
growth_areas in compute_weighted_score only includes categories with score<70 — if all 9 categories >=70 the list is empty; consider surfacing a 'no growth areas — great job!' state on the frontend.
seed_data_creation: Created a test child 'TEST_AssessKid' age 10 during backend tests; auto-cleaned in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_assessment_v2.py. Run with: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_assessment_v2.py -o addopts='' -v . Frontend route for assessment is /dashboard/child/:childId/assessment (NOT /dashboard/assessment/:childId as the spec incorrectly stated). data-testids used: answer-option-{0..3}, assessment-next-btn, assessment-question-meta.
rca of the issue: No issues found — v2 assessment & question-bank feature works end-to-end.
